    private static readonly int[] Flags = [36, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 100, 84, 84, 84, 84, 84, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 76, 66, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65];
    private static readonly ulong[] Observations = new ulong[6];

    public static int Run(int input)
    {
        for (var index = 0; index < Observations.Length; index++) Observations[index] = 0;
        var bits = Bits[input];
        var value = BitConverter.UInt16BitsToHalf(bits);
        Observations[0] = BitConverter.HalfToUInt16Bits(value);
        if (Observations[0] != bits) return -1;
        var signedValue = BitConverter.Int16BitsToHalf(unchecked((short)bits));
        if (BitConverter.HalfToInt16Bits(signedValue) != unchecked((short)bits)) return -2;
        var nan = (Flags[input] & 1) != 0;
        var single = (float)value;
        var wide = (double)value;
        if (nan)
        {
            Observations[1] = float.IsNaN(single) ? 1UL : 0;
            Observations[2] = double.IsNaN(wide) ? 1UL : 0;
            if (Observations[1] != 1 || Observations[2] != 1) return -3;
        }
        else
        {
            Observations[1] = BitConverter.SingleToUInt32Bits(single);
            Observations[2] = BitConverter.DoubleToUInt64Bits(wide);
            if (Observations[1] != SingleBits[input]) return -4;
            if (Observations[2] != DoubleBits[input]) return -5;
        }
        var singleBack = (Half)single;
        var doubleBack = (Half)wide;
        Observations[3] = nan ? (Half.IsNaN(singleBack) ? 1UL : 0) : BitConverter.HalfToUInt16Bits(singleBack);
        Observations[4] = nan ? (Half.IsNaN(doubleBack) ? 1UL : 0) : BitConverter.HalfToUInt16Bits(doubleBack);
        var expectedBack = nan ? 1UL : bits;
        if (Observations[3] != expectedBack) return -6;
        if (Observations[4] != expectedBack) return -7;
        var flags = (Half.IsNaN(value) ? 1 : 0) |
            (Half.IsInfinity(value) ? 2 : 0) |
            (Half.IsFinite(value) ? 4 : 0) |
            (Half.IsNormal(value) ? 8 : 0) |
            (Half.IsSubnormal(value) ? 16 : 0) |
            (value == (Half)0 ? 32 : 0) |
            (Half.IsNegative(value) ? 64 : 0);
        Observations[5] = (ulong)flags;
        return flags == Flags[input] ? 42 : -8;
    }

    public static int Trace() => 6;
    public static int TraceCount() => 6;
    public static int TraceKind(int index) => 3;
    public static int TraceEventId(int index) => index;
    public static int TracePayloadLow(int index) => unchecked((int)Observations[index]);
    public static int TracePayloadHigh(int index) => unchecked((int)(Observations[index] >> 32));
}
